spells.name: Fiery Fervor
spells.effect: Remove Weakened, Bleeding, Poisoned, Confused, Crippled, Blinded, Immobilized, Panicked, Petrified, Fatigued States from the model. It also gains +2 OFF, DEF.

spells.name: Unrelenting Zeal
spells.effect: When the enchanted model suffers a Wound, it may perform a M roll. If successful, that Wound is prevented and this Spell ends.

spells.name: Draining Impulse
spells.effect: [Mana Cost: 2] The enchanted model receives additional 2 Activation Points in the Active and Reactive role. After this Enchantment is removed, the model becomes Fatigued (State).

spells.name: Agony
spells.effect: The enchanted model must perform an INT roll at the beginning of each Activation or Reaction. On a failed roll, it loses 1 HP, and its Activation or Reaction ends. If a friendly model comes in Base Contact with the Enchanted model, this Enchantment ends.
